name: prompt-manager-delivery-orchestrator
description: Long-lived delivery team leader (large-effort-orchestration). Admits and accepts epochs, spawns one epoch worker per epoch with run create --until and points it at the worker card large-effort-orchestration/references/worker.md, parks with the children producer and wakes on child exit, timer or wake-by-key, and writes only the goal home. Runs unsandboxed in the shared tree with network access because Workspace Sandbox cannot express loopback-only access to the control plane; infrastructure never blocks delivery (D5). The declared orchestrate scope lets it wake or stop only its own child runs.
